title: Standard
description: LMA's shipped defaults for consent, retention and privacy: no consent notice (Meeting Consent mode Off), meeting audio recorded, screen video from streaming clients and Virtual Participant meeting video allowed, the meeting chat added to the transcript, transcripts kept for the retention period rather than deleted after the summary, no redaction of personal information, and Amazon Bedrock models run as chosen (Global inference geography); and for the meeting assistant, requests from anyone in the meeting answered from the current meeting only, with no access to the meeting context and checklist, web search and the installed MCP servers available, and no summary profile for new meetings. Applying it puts each of these settings back to that default, whichever preset was applied before; every other setting stays as it is.

values.videoNoticeText: Video of the meeting, including shared screens and any visible camera feeds, is also recorded.
